english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for pulling something toward oneself.
This is the all-purpose choice for physically pulling something, including a body part or curtain.

examples.english: Pull the chair over here first.
examples.jyutping: nei5 laai1 zoeng1 dang3 maai4 lei4 sin1
laai1 hoi1 zoeng1 lim4 sin1 laa1

english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for taking someone into police custody.
Use this colloquial word when police arrest or take someone into custody.
Use 拉 as the all-purpose colloquial verb when the police arrest someone.

examples.english: Whenever that thief causes trouble, the police arrest him.
examples.traditional: 嗰個賊一惹事，警察就拉佢。

examples.english: I watched the police apprehend a wanted criminal yesterday.
